tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the shop catalogue. Give words (query), a category, a maximum price in cents or only products in stock. Returns up to 8 products (id, name, price_formatted, available, summary, options such as colour or size) and answer_kind: exact (they match), relaxed or related (NOT exact: only the closest

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything the shop says about one product: description in plain text, key facts, the options (colour, size) with their available values, variants with price and availability, delivery time and frequently asked questions. Call it whenever the customer asks about a product ("tell me about it", "what

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The product categories of the shop with their sub-categories (what the shop sells), and popular: the categories of the best sellers, first the one that sells most.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Whether a product (or one of its variants) can be bought in a given quantity right now, and what that quantity costs: unit_price and total (unit price × quantity, calculated by the shop). When the customer asks how much several units cost, call it with that qty and say its total: never multiply your

tools.name: shipping_quote
tools.description: Delivery options, prices and times to a destination. Give the postcode (and the 2-letter country if it is not the shop's own). Quotes the product given, or the current cart when no product is given.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: About the shop itself and its policies: what the shop is and sells in its own words (about), returns (the deadline and the text of the returns page, with its link), shipping and terms pages, accepted payment methods, how the invoice reaches the customer (invoices), contact details and opening hours.

tools.name: cart_view
tools.description: The customer's cart: lines, quantities, prices and totals, as the shop calculates them.

tools.name: cart_add
tools.description: Add units of a product to the customer's cart. The price is always the shop's own; it cannot be given. A product with variants needs its variant_id: without it you get need=options with the choices (the shop shows them as buttons): ask which one the customer wants and call again with that variant_id

tools.name: cart_update
tools.description: Change the quantity of a cart line (the key comes from cart_view). Quantity 0 removes the line.

tools.name: checkout_link
tools.description: The address of the checkout page with the customer's cart, where they review and pay. Payment always happens there.

tools.name: checkout_status
tools.description: Where the purchase is: what is still missing (contact, address, shipping, payment, in the order to ask for it), the cart summary and what is already saved. Personal data come masked. Call it before asking the customer anything about their order.

tools.name: checkout_set_customer
tools.description: Save the customer's details for this order. Pass every detail in its OWN field, already separated: first_name, last_name, email, phone, line1 (street and number), line2 (floor and door), postcode, city, region, country, company and vat_id. Put only the value in each field, never the label or the sen

tools.name: checkout_shipping_options
tools.description: The delivery options for the order with their price and delay, and the one selected. Needs the delivery address first.

tools.name: checkout_set_shipping
tools.description: Choose the delivery option (carrier_id from checkout_shipping_options).

tools.name: checkout_payment_options
tools.description: The payment methods offered for the order, with their kind (offline: transfer or cash on delivery; redirect: paid online) and any fee, and the one selected.

tools.name: checkout_set_payment
tools.description: Choose the payment method (method = the id from checkout_payment_options).

tools.name: checkout_review
tools.description: The exact order that would be placed: lines, discounts, shipping, taxes, the total (total_cents and total formatted), the delivery address and the payment method, and the confirm_token that checkout_place needs. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "checkout_place" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Place the order. Needs the confirm_token of the last checkout_review, buyer_confirmed true (you declare that the person has seen the total and said yes) and one…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cart_add, checkout_review · Private data: store_info, checkout_status, checkout_review, checkout_place · Public sink: checkout_set_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cart_add, checkout_review · Private data: store_info, checkout_status, checkout_review, checkout_place · Public sink: checkout_set_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
